colour_meaning: Check: not scored. Either a tested “looks fine on paper” pattern, or a single weak sign (for example an unusual price) that alone is not enough to score.

items.label: One bidder
items.detail: 1 bidder(s) recorded. Not linked to failed contracts in past data, so not scored.

items.label: Total budget above the 95th percentile (length not stated)
items.detail: Official budget ₱148.5M with no stated length; the 95th percentile for Access / tourism road is ₱106.1M.

items.label: Road contracts from other agencies (PhilGEPS)
items.detail: Balintugan Construction also won 2 road contract(s) worth ₱20.1M from 2 other procuring entities (2022–2024), e.g. National Irrigation Administration - Ilocos Norte Irrigation, Province Of Benguet. PhilGEPS awards record no outcome, so this is not scored.

families.name: Contractor ownership, affiliation and bidding networks

items.label: Weak: most of the winner's recent CPES evaluations are behind schedule
items.detail: Balintugan Construction: of 33 CPES evaluation(s) of its other DPWH contracts in the last 3 years, 13 (39%) were behind schedule. Worst, on 2023-11-21: 8.3% negative slippage during construction (CPES scored schedule 0.067 of 0.15) (contract not stated).

items.label: Winner's other on-going roads
items.detail: Balintugan Construction has 0 on-going DPWH road(s) possibly stalled and 1 far behind schedule (weekly stage-3 list; DPWH progress data can lag).

assessment.derivation: 0 strong + 1 weak signal → below Medium (needs 1 strong or 2 weak); a single weak sign is shown as a Blue check case.

steps.title: Confirm the basic facts on the official DPWH page
sub: Budget, location, status, dates and bidders match this page.

steps.title: Open the bid documents
sub: Look for the quantities, a Bill of Quantities and technical specifications.

steps.title: Read Claude's check and confirm its points against the sources
Verify the risk: Implementation delays and performance anomalies
sub: Compare DPWH's reported progress with citizen reports, Bisto.ph inspections and satellite images.

If CPES is cited: open the DPWH quarterly CPES report for that date and confirm the contract, the slippage and the scores. A CPES rating is the agency's own evaluation; ask the district office for the evaluation sheet and the catch-up programme.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check the site before work starts: satellite imagery of the stretch, earlier contracts on the same road, and whether a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, a TPM civil-society partner) can take geotagged photos later.

steps.title: Write down what you found and keep the documents you relied on
sub: Screenshots, Bill of Quantities pages, photos or letters: attach them with your decision.
